falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the August 2024 high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, which requires price to remain below prior resistance. This would signal a new uptrend rather than a bottoming phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on BTC perpetuals exceeds 0.05% for 3 consecutive 8-hour periods while price is above $68,000
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained positive funding at elevated price levels would indicate leveraged longs are aggressively entering, contradicting the HOLD signal which assumes weak conviction and low speculative interest typical of a bottoming phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC dominance drops below 48% while ETH/BTC ratio rises above 0.065 within the same 14-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rotation into altcoins with ETH outperforming BTC would invalidate the macro HOLD call, which assumes BTC remains the primary liquidity sink during bottoming. This rotation pattern typically marks the start of a risk-on expansion phase, not a bottom.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
